lines.n: A white mare waits unbound at the tree line, coat like fresh snow in moonlight. She lowers her head, of all things, as the beast passes.

lines.t: North. Toward faerie territory. Live with him, not die. Live.

do.text: Ride north behind the beast. (Hold W. Press E near him to speak.)

lines.t: What manner of faerie are you?

lines.n: He doesn't bother to turn around. Fair enough. She killed his friend.

lines.t: Does it even matter to you, human?

lines.n: She opens her mouth to ask again. A growl of annoyance. A charged, metallic tang stings her nose.
Exhaustion slams down. Blackness swallows her whole.
She wakes with a jolt atop the horse, held by invisible bonds. The sun is high. Birds flit past; a mild breeze kisses her face.

lines.t: My prison or my salvation. I couldn't decide which.
